name: New TermDefined subscription crossed with partner + currency at convert (term fields + discount + FX carry to order)

proc_mechanism: ProrationTermDefined PTC + Partner Discount + Currency Conversion all on quote, then whole proc re-run on OrderItem context after convert; OrderEntitiesMapping must hydrate PTC, partner %, and currency
expected_behavior: OrderItem net = currency-converted list × (1−partner%) with PTC and EndDate populated; order activates without REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING; identical to quote
